classification.countable_rule: excludes optional ingredients, water, salt, black pepper, and cooking oils
classification.notes: Effort: marinade + herb/sauce prep (1); short sear and wilt, otherwise boil-and-drain (1); fish + noodles + nước chấm (1); sear with gentle turning (1); pot + skillet (1). Sum 5 = moderate. Complexity: 14 countable ingredients (salt, pepper, oil, water excluded) -> 1; fish sauce and rice vermicelli are international-aisle staples at major chains -> 1; marinade + nước chấm builds -> 1; sourcing scored once -> 0. Sum 3 = standard. Cuisine unfamiliarity adds nothing. Matches WAVE proposal.
